## Summary

Describe the change and why it is useful.

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated
- [ ] Cluster-specific commands/configuration were validated, or are clearly marked unverified

## Security

- [ ] No credentials, internal network details or private data added
- [ ] No arbitrary model-controlled shell execution added
- [ ] Mutating operations retain explicit approval and least privilege
